description: A dominant goblin leader who is still small, wiry, ugly-cunning, and unmistakably goblinoid; authority comes from posture, trophies, and scavenged rank gear rather than human nobility or brute size. Compact agile humanoid, slightly sturdier than a common goblin but still lean, small, and quick rather than orc-bulky or heroic. Mostly bare skin with a few scars or wrinkles and sparse hair only; no fur-covered or fluffy silhouette.

signature_gear: bent sword or decorated crude blade
